text:
Re-read at the cluster-label change. Every claim in this witness still holds and the docstring still describes it: it lifts draw() and its batching out of the SHIPPED template and executes them against a real payload with a recording context, because a green suite proves the template parses and nothing more.

What changed: draw() now calls drawClusterLabels(), so the probe lifts that function too. Lifted rather than stubbed, deliberately - a stub would let the label pass rot unexecuted, which is exactly the failure this witness exists to catch.

Recorded because it cost a real diagnosis: the OTHER jsdom probes stub getContext with a proxy that answers a no-op function for every method. measureText RETURNS A VALUE, and the label code reads .width off it, so those probes reported "the emitted page threw while loading" for a page no browser would fail on. The stub modelled the API badly enough to invent a defect. Any canvas method with a return value has to be modelled, not blanked - measureText is the one that exists today.
